rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Truly a magnificent sight! From here, a new Black History begins!
rows.display_text:
「Truly a magnificent sight! From here, a
new Black History begins!」

rows.speaker: Gagarn
rows.en: Gym Ghingnham. As long as I and Gargos exist, we cannot know defeat.
rows.display_text:
「Gym Ghingnham. As long as I and Gargos
exist, we cannot know defeat.」

rows.speaker: Alex
rows.en: Victory is already assured. It was worth leaving the City, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Victory is already assured. It was
worth leaving the City, after all.」

rows.speaker: Kizz
rows.en: No one exists who can stop us. The tracks get laid after we've already passed.
rows.display_text:
「No one exists who can stop us. The
tracks get laid after we've already
passed.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: You gents seem awful pleased with yourselves, but ain't it a bit early to be celebrating a win?
rows.display_text:
「You gents seem awful pleased with
yourselves, but ain't it a bit early to be
celebrating a win?」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Anyone who gets in the way just gets crushed. At least with this crowd, it doesn't look like I'll be bored.
rows.display_text:
「Anyone who gets in the way just gets
crushed. At least with this crowd, it
doesn't look like I'll be bored.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: No matter who shows up, I don't intend to lose. I've got the power in my hands to back that up.
rows.display_text:
「No matter who shows up, I don't intend
to lose. I've got the power in my hands
to back that up.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Looks like your playmates have arrived, boys. ...Don't let your guard down.
rows.display_text:
「Looks like your playmates have arrived,
boys. ...Don't let your guard down.」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Same goes for you...!
rows.display_text: 「Same goes for you...!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Welcome, Dianna Soreil! You too should celebrate -- the day the Black History begins!
rows.display_text:
「Welcome, Dianna Soreil! You too should
celebrate -- the day the Black History
begins!」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Silence, Gym Ghingnham. I won't let this world fall into the hands of a man like you.
rows.display_text:
「Silence, Gym Ghingnham. I won't let this
world fall into the hands of a man like
you.」

rows.speaker: Gagarn
rows.en: Bold words. But can that force of yours really stand against us?
rows.display_text:
「Bold words. But can that force of
yours really stand against us?」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Gagarn! I'll show you the answer by taking you down!
rows.display_text:
「Gagarn! I'll show you the answer by
taking you down!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Remember this, boys. There are opponents out there you couldn't beat even standing on your heads.
rows.display_text:
「Remember this, boys. There are
opponents out there you couldn't beat
even standing on your heads.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Shut it! That's as far as your big talk goes! Get ready, Timp!
rows.display_text:
「Shut it! That's as far as your big talk
goes! Get ready, Timp!」

rows.speaker: Yazan
rows.en: Ha! Better make this fun! If you go down easy, there's no point in me coming out here!
rows.display_text:
「Ha! Better make this fun! If you go
down easy, there's no point in me coming
out here!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Yazan...! If you're going to spread this fighting further, we'll stop you!
rows.display_text:
「Yazan...! If you're going to spread this
fighting further, we'll stop you!」

rows.speaker: Alex
rows.en: Then let's have a look at your last stand, gentlemen.
rows.display_text:
「Then let's have a look at your last
stand, gentlemen.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Very well, Alex. I'll consider negotiations with you already broken down, and answer force with force.
rows.display_text:
「Very well, Alex. I'll consider
negotiations with you already broken down,
and answer force with force.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: All units, deploy! We begin our attack now!
rows.display_text:
「All units, deploy! We begin our attack
now!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: A drawn-out fight favors them! Operation time is nine minutes! Settle this before it runs out!
rows.display_text:
「A drawn-out fight favors them!
Operation time is nine minutes! Settle
this before it runs out!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Confirmed: the enemy force has been wiped out.
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed: the enemy force has been
wiped out.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Good work, everyone. This is our victory.
rows.display_text:
「Good work, everyone. This is our
victory.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: But I doubt those men will just give up after this.
rows.display_text:
「But I doubt those men will just give up
after this.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: If they start another fight, then we'll just have to take them on again.
rows.display_text:
「If they start another fight, then we'll
just have to take them on again.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Yes... That's exactly what our strength and our resolve are for.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... That's exactly what our strength
and our resolve are for.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Thank you, everyone.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you, everyone.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Now then, let's go home -- each of us, to the ones waiting for us.
rows.display_text:
「Now then, let's go home -- each of us,
to the ones waiting for us.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Captain! At this rate, our losses will exceed the limit!
rows.display_text:
「Captain! At this rate, our losses will
exceed the limit!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: One minute...! If we can't settle this in that one minute, we fall back...!
rows.display_text:
「One minute...! If we can't settle this
in that one minute, we fall back...!」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Everyone, steel yourselves! Pour everything you have into this one minute!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, steel yourselves! Pour
everything you have into this one minute!」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: Nine minutes of operation time have passed!
rows.display_text:
「Nine minutes of operation time have
passed!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: If we keep fighting like this, our losses will reach a fatal level!
rows.display_text:
「If we keep fighting like this, our
losses will reach a fatal level!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: ...It can't be helped! All units, fall back!
rows.display_text:
「...It can't be helped! All units, fall
back!」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Are we truly unable to stop the Black History...?
rows.display_text:
「Are we truly unable to stop the Black
History...?」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Gym Ghingnham is deploying his forces, you say?
rows.display_text:
「Gym Ghingnham is deploying his forces,
you say?」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: That man must intend to gather his forces and set off the Black History war himself.
rows.display_text:
「That man must intend to gather his
forces and set off the Black History war
himself.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Stopping that is our duty. Let's launch immediately.
rows.display_text:
「Stopping that is our duty. Let's launch
immediately.」

rows.speaker: Milan
rows.en: But, Captain Jamil... our forces are limited.
rows.display_text:
「But, Captain Jamil... our forces are
limited.」

rows.speaker: Milan
rows.en: And on top of that, Ghingnham has made all manner of forces his own.
rows.display_text:
「And on top of that, Ghingnham has made
all manner of forces his own.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: According to the recon unit's report, the following units have been confirmed.
rows.display_text:
「According to the recon unit's report,
the following units have been confirmed.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Turn X, the Emperor Custom, a Hambrabi squadron, the Destroy Gundam, Gargos, the Dominator, Big Fau...
rows.display_text:
「Turn X, the Emperor Custom, a Hambrabi
squadron, the Destroy Gundam, Gargos, the
Dominator, Big Fau...」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: The rest of their forces are nothing to underestimate either.
rows.display_text:
「The rest of their forces are nothing
to underestimate either.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Even so, we must go. We cannot allow the Black History to come again.
rows.display_text:
「Even so, we must go. We cannot allow
the Black History to come again.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: I feel the same... and so does everyone else.
rows.display_text:
「I feel the same... and so does everyone
else.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Sara, notify everyone to prepare for launch.
rows.display_text:
「Sara, notify everyone to prepare for
launch.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: Understood, Captain.
rows.display_text: 「Understood, Captain.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Also, the enemy is expected to field considerable forces, starting with the Turn X. Pay the utmost attention to your setups.
rows.display_text:
「Also, expect considerable enemy forces,
starting with the Turn X. Pay utmost
attention to your setups.」
